description: Our nowcast of BLS's CPI food-at-home inflation (year on year) for a month, before BLS publishes it, with our own index for BLS's six food-at-home groups, from what shoppers paid at US high-low grocery chains (x402, USDC on Base). Priced by lead time: $250 15+ days before BLS's release, $100 7-14 days, $25 the last week, $0.01 after (scored against BLS). For inflation questions, not company sales.

month.description: YYYY-MM (default: the next BLS release on offer)
